cases.name: Michelle Ann Krek
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Mikie" was truly one of a kind and the anchor to her family. She was a beautiful person inside and out, funny, one of the kindest souls with a heart of gold, loyal and would do absolutely anything for anyone. Both compassionate and charismatic, she would just light up any room she was in. She was beyond excited to be a mom to her baby boy, Logan.
